title: skills(os-dev, pm-dispatch): every PR opens with a six-line 维护者速读; the seat's 席位核对 precedes pr_ready/enqueue; H69 patrols a summons that ran ahead of it
body:
Fixes #26155
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
改了什么:每个 PR 正文现在都以这块六行速读开头(受管与否都带),其后英文节序固定、门禁日志折进可展开块;席位在你被请审之前先把自己的核对贴到当前 head;巡查多一行报告态 H69,点名「已请审、席位核对却没跟上 head」的 Tier H PR。
为什么改:你的原话「看一下现在的pr写的内容，我总感觉对我审核的人帮助不大，是否需要更新skills」→「立卡」;立卡实测 35 个 open PR 首节名不统一、中文只在 6 个受管草稿里、其中 4 个没有席位终稿。
风险与回滚:只改两份规则文本与一行报告态巡查,不改任何门禁判定、不动复核清单;出错时你看到的是 PR 正文形状不对或 H69 多报一行,不阻塞任何落地。回滚 = revert 本 PR 的一个 commit。
先看:`.claude/agents/os-dev.md`(新五行是模板本体;退掉的三行去向见 Acceptance notes)→ `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`(① 行:席位核对先于 `pr_ready`/入队)→ `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`(风险 hunk = `h69SeatRecordBehindHead` 里 head 日期与记录时间的比较)。
两分钟验证:`node scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs --self-test`,预期末行含 `H69 seat record before governed review 66/40`;`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet`,预期 `os-dev.md is 404 lines (ceiling 404; headroom 0)`。
需要你做的:确认或改这六个标签——这块就是模板本体,它的形状在本 PR 上由你定;落地由席位走 Tier S 契约复核,不需要你点合并。

## What changes

**`.claude/agents/os-dev.md` — 404 → 404 lines (ceiling 404).** Lines 288–289 (the governed-only `## 维护者速读(草稿)` with 五段 including 席位意见) become five rule lines, now 285–289: the block on every PR right after the two declaration lines; the six labels verbatim and in order; the `先看` and `两分钟验证` sub-rules; `需要你做的` = exactly one action, `无,席位落地` on a non-governed PR; and the fixed English section order (What changes / Tests / Acceptance notes / Verification) with every log reading folded into a details/summary block. Three lines retired to pay for them, each to a home it already had:
- old 273 (push with `-u`, back off on network failure, pre-push refuses card trailers) → rule 1 lines 30 and 32, and base line 285 (now 282: no card trailer on a commit);
- old 275 (after the PR opens, merge `main` only on a conflict, a main-red or a dequeue, then the scoped re-check) → AGENTS.md Multi-agent discipline §10, which states it verbatim;
- old 284 (the three safe spellings beside a card number: `is not addressed here`, `out of scope:`, `remains open`) → the keyword rule directly above it (base 282–283, now 280–281, 「让它们远离其它卡号」) and review-checklist.md:10 安全拼法 (卡号旁零动词).

**`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` — 319 → 319 lines (ceiling 319); four lines rewritten in place, no new line.** ① (188): the seat's record is on the PR before `pr_ready` (Tier H) and before enqueue (Tier S), pinned to the head — the single home of the Wanted-2 precondition; `两层同欠` is carried by naming both triggers, `卡只留指针行` by execution-duties.md:184 and the pointer spelling on 190. 192: the six labels. 193: the dev's block on every PR, no 席位意见 line. 194: the seat corrects the six lines and adds the 席位意见 line.

**`scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` — H69, report-only (35,243 → 35,593 lines).** Population = H48's (governed, Tier H, open, drafts in) narrowed to a pending request from a `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` account; it fires when no comment whose line begins `## 席位核对` is newer than the head's committer date. It reuses the thread H48 buys and adds ONE commit read per PR that carries a record at all — a PR with no record is judged without that read, an unread head date is UNJUDGED, never clean. A sibling of H43, not a widening: H43 asks who was asked, H69 whether the record preceded the asking, and the two remedies differ. Coverage pair `seatRecordCandidates`/`seatRecordJudged`, summary clause `Seat records (H69)`, band `state`, a 66-case battery pinned at 40. H48's hint text and fixture follow the renamed dev heading: the body section is now `## 维护者速读`, the same heading as the comment marker, H48 still reads comments only, and a new case proves the fixture carries that heading so the pin is not vacuous.

**Not touched.** `references/review-checklist.md` (card ⛔ 3). `references/landing-operations.md`: its Tier S enqueue line — the order's candidate home — no longer exists on `origin/main` (#26210 retired it), and the surviving line 60 sits at 115 bytes with no room for a fold, so the precondition has one home. No open PR body was rewritten. AGENTS.md untouched.

## Tests

- `node scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs --self-test` on `b04d9371`: exit 0 — `✓ check-half-states self-test: 5030 cases pass. Batteries: … H69 seat record before governed review 66/40`. The pair the card pins is `H69: approver requested, record OLDER than the head -> finding` and `H69: approver requested, record NEWER than the head -> clean`, with the controls beside them: no record needs no head read; an unread head date is UNJUDGED; a non-approver or assign-only request does not fire; Tier S stands down; a new push after a fresh record re-opens the state; H43/H48 adjacency.
- No ablation: the diff changes rule text and a patrol script, not a tested runtime behaviour (os-dev.md: 配置、脚本、workflow、文档 ⛔ 不消融).

## Acceptance notes

- **Premise — relay request timing (measured; it shapes the wording).** `fleet-write/execute.mjs` requests `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` at `pr_create` AND at `pr_ready` on a Tier H hit (its battery name at execute.mjs:1046; AGENTS.md Prime Directive 14 calls the draft-time request a summons). So the precondition cannot bind the create-time request; SKILL.md ① binds `pr_ready` and enqueue, and H69 reads the pending request as the summons it is — a fresh Tier H draft fires until the seat's record lands on its head, which is the measured shape (4 of 6 governed drafts on the filing day).
- **Premise — the details/summary fold (unmeasured until this PR).** 0 of 28 open and 0 of 100 recently closed PR bodies carried a details tag (REST `GET /pulls`, read 2026-10-26T20:25Z); platform-readings.md records the write-side sanitizer deleting unknown tag shapes and says nothing about this element. This PR's own `## Verification` is the measurement: if the folds below render, the rule line stands; if they were stripped, the seat has the reading and the fold needs a different spelling.
- **Ruling A on #25919 (comment 6386217274) answers 404** — NOT MEASURED, evidence destroyed. The card's quotation of it (「规范核心与事故史分家」) and the surviving ruling 6407900763 on that card point the same way, and nothing here depends on it.
- **Recognisers re-grepped before and after** (`速读|五段|席位意见|Acceptance notes|维护者速读|席位核对` over `.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/*.mjs`): none is keyed on `(草稿)` or `五段`. `MAINTAINER_BRIEF_MARKER` (H48) reads comments only and is unchanged; `fleet-roster.mjs` reads `## 席位核对` plus ACCEPT, unchanged; `check-governed-merges.mjs`, `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` and `dispatch-gates.mjs` say "a final 维护者速读" in prose, still true; `post-stamped.mjs`'s `席位意见` opener belongs to the decision-analysis frame, unrelated; `references/decision-analysis.md:13` keeps its one-line governed-draft summary — the seat's decision-box line, not the PR brief.
- **Tier.** The only governed paths are `.claude/**` → Tier S: this PR stays draft; the seat's independent `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review and the queue are the landing. The dev did not ready, arm or enqueue it. `skip-changeset` rides `pr_create`'s labels: `.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/**` publish nothing.
- **Out of scope, not filed:** none. The `os-dev.md:292` token-count clause (「姊妹门禁定义 token 计数后同报 token」) names a gate that does not exist; noted as a candidate for the next compression, not retired here.
